data.text: Conclusions stay proposals until a human promotes them; promotion is the only path from assertion to established fact, so the record cannot self-establish.

Ledger event ids are content-derived and never reused; corrections append superseding events instead of rewriting, and the wai adapter skips unchanged artifacts on re-import so replays stay idempotent.
Content-derived artifact attributes (title, title_digest) never feed the event id, so re-observing an edited artifact keeps its identity while the title moves.
Release claims are checked mechanically: the status document must agree with the Cargo.toml version, so shipped docs cannot drift from the manifest.
A publication product without a populated backing block is omitted and reported with reason no-backing-document; the tree never carries stub pages, so absence is always truthful.

Doc audit 2026-11-24: the kaya-managed human surface was navigational, not explanatory - getting-started and reference were citation stubs, five products and two collections had no backing documents, and newcomer comprehension flowed around kaya through README and openspec specs.

The omission machinery was honest about absence but silent about the unblock path; the admission table and feeder rules were source-code-only knowledge until kaya explain made them first-class CLI answers.
